"We leave at dawn," said Rhys. "No." I’d lied, and he knew it.

Rhys’s voice was cold. "Go," he said. "Now."

"Perhaps," said Cassian. Again I felt the cold, and Like a storm it grew.

Mor’s laugh rang out. "Moods," Mor said. "Rhys’s moods."

"Fine." He’d won, and Cassian said nothing. "Fine," Cassian said at last.

"Never." Again Amren frowned. "Never," said Amren. "Like before."

Cassian’s wings shifted. "Enough," Cassian said. "I’d say so."

"Always." Like Mor, Rhys smiled. "Always," said Rhys. I’d never seen it.

"Truly?" Again Feyre said nothing. "Truly," said Mor.

Amren’s eyes narrowed. "Hm," Amren said. "Again?"
